notes: No official site found. The Rentable page names it 'The Summit at Uptown' but gives the address as 100 Hoopers Ln, not 1820 N Main St. Other listings group 100-220 Hoopers Ln with 1740-1816 Staniel Dr, so this is probably the same townhome community off N Main. The page says it is not accepting new tenants, and both listed units are 'Rented', so prices may be stale. The required 'Benefit Package' (amount not shown) is a likely hidden fee.
